BLOGBY STEPHANIE MOSS, MD

Insights from the 2023 ISSWSH Conference: Advancements in Women's Sexual Health Research

This past week I had the honor of attending the 2023 Conference of International Society for the Study of Women's Sexual Health (ISSWSH.org). Here are some of the topics and the new research that stood out to me. Sex Therapy History & Goals Sexual Pain Disorders - Understandings & Treatments Understanding the factors affecting a Sexual Response: Goals of Sexual Health Therapy: Sexual Health Promotion Strategies: Carter, J., Stabile, C., Seidel, B., Baser, R. E., Goldfarb, S., & Goldfrank, D. J. (2017). Vaginal and sexual health treatment strategies within a female sexual medicine program for cancer patients and survivors. Journal of cancer survivorship : research and practice, 11(2), 274–283. https://doi.org/10.1007/s11764-016-0585-9 Pain Related Disorders - A Bio-Psycho-Social Understanding Biological Possible Causes of Pain: Mast Cell Research by Dempsey Dempsey et.al. Diagnosis of mast cell activation syndrome: a global "consensus-2". Diagnosis (Berl). 2020 Apr 22;8(2):137-152. doi: 10.1515/dx-2020-0005. PMID: 32324159. Fatty Acid Inflammatory Research by Falsetta Falsetta Ml (et. el). Specialized Pro-resolving Mediators Reduce Pro-nociceptive Inflammatory Mediator Production in Models of Localized Provoked Vulvodynia. J Pain. 2021 Oct;22(10):1195-1209. doi: 10.1016/j.jpain.2021.03.144. Epub 2021 Apr 1. PMID: 33813057; PMCID: PMC8484336. Local Inflammatory Nerve Response by Dantzer Dantzer R. Neuroimmune Interactions: From the Brain to the Immune System and Vice Versa. Physiol Rev. 2018 Jan 1;98(1):477-504. doi: 10.1152/physrev.00039.2016. PMID: 29351513; PMCID: PMC5866360.
